note: Both sets cover the same eight facts with correct values, units, conditions and supporting quotes, so the difference is in entity binding. Set A attributes the R-50 insulation resistance to 'SIPs manufacturing', whereas the page states it as an insulation resistance option of the SIPs themselves (available through manufacturing); Set B binds it to SIPs correctly. Set B's remaining entity and attribute labels are equally faithful, so it is marginally better.
remarks: Both sets label the 16.3/6.5/20.2/54.7% values as a difference 'vs baseline'/'from baseline'; the page only says eQuest loads are that much higher (implicitly than the BEoptE+ estimates), so the baseline wording is an interpretation neither quote fully supports. Both also omit the qualitative finding that BEoptE+ HVAC sizing recommendations remain sufficient despite the higher eQuest loads.
